title: Meet Cory, the humanoid robot working at a Waterloo repair shop
key_facts: Columbia Auto Group, a repair shop in Waterloo, Ontario, has a humanoid robot at its front counter.
It is built with Cory AI, described as a Canadian-owned AI developer.
CBC K-W reporter Lauren Kuivenhoven visited the shop to see it at work.
quote_evidence: Columbia Auto Group has a humanoid robot at its front counter.
It's name is Cory, and it's built with Cory AI, a Canadian owned AI developer.
why_it_matters_hint: A humanoid robot is being used in a customer-facing role at a small local business.
notes: Only the short CBC video description was available; the video itself was not viewed and no other outlet carries it (Yahoo News Canada lists the same CBC item). What the robot actually does at the counter is not stated, so the summary does not say.
